verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim an Obsidian Sync 'headless client' explicitly designed for CI pipelines and automated agent workflows, but the independent runtime probe found Obsidian ships no official CLI or vendor automation interface, with only community-built (unofficial) tooling for programmatic access — directly contradicting the headless-CI claim. Missing for 10: independent confirmation the headless Sync client actually exists and works, official CLI documentation, and evidence of real CI usage.
